CustomField.description: API name of the Apex class that implements PayloadCodec. The engine encodes workflow input, step output, step state and signal payloads with it before it stores them. The engine decodes them after it reads them. Blank selects the identity codec: payloads are stored unchanged. If the name is not a valid PayloadCodec, every payload write throws. A read of an encoded value also throws.
CustomField.label: Payload Codec
